description: Source code for the GameManager class implementing the core game logic for a 2048-like game, including game setup, tile movement, merging, and game state management.

classes.name: GameManager
classes.description: Main class managing game state, user interactions, and game logic for 2048.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the game by clearing the game state and setting up a new game.

methods.name: keepPlaying
methods.description: Allows the game to continue after reaching 2048 tile, enabling further moves.

methods.name: isGameTerminated
methods.description: Checks if the game is over due to win/loss conditions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the game state, either from saved data or fresh start.

methods.name: addStartTiles
methods.description: Adds initial tiles to start the game.

methods.name: addRandomTile
methods.description: Adds a new tile in a random available position.

methods.name: actuate
methods.description: Updates the game display and saves the current state.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the current game state into an object.

methods.name: prepareTiles
methods.description: Prepares tiles for movement by saving positions and clearing merge info.

methods.name: moveTile
methods.description: Moves a tile to a new position.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Executes a move in the specified direction, handling tile merging and game over conditions.

methods.name: getVector
methods.description: Returns movement vector for a given direction.

methods.name: buildTraversals
methods.description: Builds traversal order for moving tiles based on direction.

methods.name: findFarthestPosition
methods.description: Finds the farthest position a tile can move to in a given direction.

methods.name: movesAvailable
methods.description: Checks if any moves are available.

methods.name: tileMatchesAvailable
methods.description: Checks if any tiles can be merged.

methods.name: positionsEqual
methods.description: Checks if two positions are the same.
